text:
sofia: follow-up on midflight handoff idea from the RFC. want to pin lifecycle boundaries for moving an active streaming session between edge proxies without forcing client reconnect.
raj: ok sketch it. main concerns: ordering, dupes, kv-cache correctness, billing.
sofia: proposed flow: client -> proxy-A. operator triggers rebalance. A marks session TRANSFERRING and requests a short-lived transfer ticket from control plane. control plane issues X-Transfer-Token scoped to proxy-B. A begins warmup: mirrors recent upstream outputs + compact KV-delta to B over an encrypted control channel. B opens upstream resume using token; both A and B may see overlapping output during grace window. after B signals ready, control plane flips routing atomically to B; A tombstones session after tombstone_ttl.
mike: duplicate delivery avoided by chunk_seq + session_uuid dedupe and tombstone map for recent seqs. also include per-chunk checksum.
jen: KV priming is tricky — deltas can be large. limit to sliding window (kv_prime_window) and make kv-prime opt-in per-tenant.
raj: client retries race: mobile might retransmit to A while routing flipped to B. extend retry tokens to include origin_proxy_id + session_uuid + chunk_seq + signature; new proxy rejects seq <= max_acked.
mike: billing overlap inevitable for short window. expose metric transfer_overlap_tokens and run reconciliation job; default grace_ms=150ms to bound cost.
sofia: sample config:
soft_handoff:
  grace_ms: 150
  tombstone_ttl_ms: 5000
  transfer_header: "X-Transfer-Token"
  kv_prime_enabled: true
  kv_prime_window: 500
  seq_sig_algo: rsa-sha256
  allow_cross_tenancy: false
jen: observability: add transfer_id to traces; metrics: transfer_overlap_tokens, transfer_latency_ms, kv_prime_size_bytes. alerts if duplicate_rate>0.5% or median_transfer_latency>120ms.
ops-bot: canary started for soft_handoff in us-east-1 (gid: ff/soft-handoff/2026-03).
sofia: action items: mike perf harness (simulate 100k streams, ETA 4d), raj token proto & signing (3d), jen dashboards + tracing (2d), sofia control-plane API prototype (5d). keep transfers intra-tenant/region for now; defer cross-backend handoffs until edge flow validated.
mike: kv-prime must be encrypted with tenant KMS keys.
sofia: thanks. leaving thread open for other edge cases.
